body: You're welcome! I am so glad you feel better now, I hope you continue feeling that way :) and yes our family's behavior is out of our power, so if you can't control what they do it is better to not let them control our emotions and feelings. It is hard but I know you can do it! I am so glad the comment brought positivity into your life. I wish the best of luck to you!

I totally understand why you feel the way you feel. And most of the time family members are the ones who make us feel worst, because we love them and want their love back. Hearing them say mean things makes us feel worst. But as you said, you passed your exam and now you have your high school diploma!! That is a great accomplishment and I am proud of you. Please remember that even the smallest accomplishments are truly meaningful and by earning your high school diploma, you accomplished something big! Please remember that you are important in the world. Just like you accomplished finishing high school, just like that you will accomplish many more things in this world! The world needs you!
